editorial.tldr: DeepSeek's retrained V4-Flash overtook the company's own flagship V4 Pro on nine agent benchmarks in late July, then a refreshed "V4 Pro 0813" build quietly appeared on OpenRouter before DeepSeek officially confirmed it as a deliberate release. That confirmation left the agent-benchmark question unresolved and no changelog published.
editorial.whats_new: State broadcaster CGTN now carries the same "enhanced AI agent capabilities" framing DeepSeek gave the confirmed launch, but still with no benchmark numbers to back it.
editorial.why_it_matters: The price hike changes the cost math that made V4 Pro competitive against V4-Flash and other cheap agent models, and the vague "agent gains" claim needs your own benchmark run before you treat it as resolving July's Flash-beats-Pro result.
editorial.take_for_builders: Re-run your agent benchmark against the now-price-hiked V4 Pro 0813 build before trusting July's Flash-beats-Pro result, and pull the new per-token pricing before deciding whether Pro or Flash is the cheaper agent option.

status.detail: DeepSeek's confirmed V4 Pro release exited preview citing agent-capability gains, alongside a Nikkei Asia report of sharply higher user pricing; state media has since repeated the same framing without new figures.

beats.headline: V4 Pro exits preview status, DeepSeek cites agent-capability gains
beats.summary: The preview-exit framing points at agent gains but no benchmark numbers accompany the claim yet; state broadcaster CGTN repeats the same "enhanced agent capabilities" line a day later, still without figures.

open_questions: Does the preview-exit build's claimed "agent gains" reclaim the benchmark lead V4-Flash took in July, or does Flash remain the stronger agent option?
What benchmark or evaluation backs the "agent gains" claim behind V4 Pro's preview exit?
How large is the new price increase, and does it still make Pro cheaper than V4-Flash per token for agent workloads?
Does DeepSeek publish a technical changelog for V4 Pro 0813 beyond the multimodal- and agent-capability claims?
